Implement a feature on the Nxeon platform (Next.js App Router + TS + Prisma + Tailwind). Work ONLY inside your worktree **/opt/nxeon-wt-idea-carousel/** (full repo copy, node_modules + .env symlinked). ALL edits use absolute paths under that dir; NEVER edit /opt/nxeon. `cd /opt/nxeon-wt-idea-carousel` for shell. Verify `npx tsc --noEmit`, fix type errors. Do NOT build/deploy/restart.

CARD — "Better carousel for game servers": the current game-server carousel isn't smooth. Redo it COMPLETELY — animated, smoothly slide-able/draggable, very premium. First Read the design ref: /opt/nxeon/board-uploads/board/cmsvf9kru001ihl1s0hio2vc6/4796d2eb24b5c4aff425a5c3.png

REQUIREMENTS: a genuinely premium games carousel — smooth momentum drag/scroll + snapping, arrows + keyboard + touch/swipe, autoplay pausing on hover, subtle depth/scale on the centered card, real game artwork, accessible, respects prefers-reduced-motion. No janky native-scroll; make the motion feel high-end. Nxeon identity: dark navy/black + electric blue/purple gradients, glass, thin borders, restrained neon.

FIRST explore: find the EXISTING game carousel component + the game/game-plan data source (grep "carousel", game lists, `db.gamePlan`, os templates with game slugs, the game-logo/poster drop-in convention). Upgrade/replace that component, kept fed by real game data; reuse existing poster/logo assets, degrade gracefully if one is missing.

SCOPE (siblings run in parallel): ONLY the marketing/landing game-server carousel component. Do NOT touch the per-server management panel, deploy wizard, pricing, or landing pages.

RETURN (final text = DATA): (1) files changed, 1 line each; (2) data source / stubs; (3) how to test (route); (4) follow-ups. No preamble.

Since the active index only updates on settle rather than continuously during drag, I can conditionally render the richer slot-selector overlay just for the active card without causing layout thrash mid-drag — the card being dragged still shows compact info until it becomes active. I'll keep card height fixed and make the overlay content absolutely positioned at the bottom so swapping between compact and detailed views is just a fade, not a resize.

I'm also planning to isolate poster loading and fallback logic into a separate `GamePoster` client subcomponent with an error-chain for resolution, and keep the exported `GameCoverCarousel` name and existing `ShowcaseGame` type import unchanged so the page itself needs no edits — minimizing the blast radius to just this one file. Also upgraded artwork resolution to use the real portrait posters and added a family→art-slug map.

**(2) Data source / stubs**
- No new data. Still fed by `ShowcaseGame[]` (type unchanged, imported from `GameShowcaseCarousel.tsx`) built server-side in `app/(marketing)/game-servers/page.tsx` from `db.gamePlan` (active plans grouped by `gameFamily`, filtered against `lib/games.ts` `GAME_FAMILIES`). All prices/slots/RAM/vCPU are DB-derived — nothing invented. Page needed no changes (same component name + props).
- Artwork chain per card, first that loads wins, all graceful: `/games/art/<artSlug>_poster.jpg` (the real posters the design ref was built from — e.g. `project-zomboid`, `7-days-to-die`, `vrising`) → `/logos/games/covers/<family>.{webp,jpg,png}` → `/logos/games/<family>.png` wordmark on brand gradient → `<GameLogo>` emoji-glyph gradient tile. New `ART_SLUG` map bridges family ids to the differing art filenames; families absent from it (minecraft, bedrock) fall straight through to the covers dir.

**(3) How to test**
- Route `/game-servers` (hero, right column). Verify: drag/flick the cards (momentum + snap), arrows, keyboard (focus the carousel, arrows/Home/End), dots, autoplay advancing every ~4.2s and pausing on hover, centered card scaling up with glow while neighbors recede/tilt, real poster art rendering, and reduced-motion (autoplay off, instant snaps). The same posters also appear on smaller `/logos/games/covers` fallbacks if art is missing.

**(4) Follow-ups**
- No poster art exists for `minecraft`/`bedrock` in `/games/art/`; they use the `covers/minecraft.jpg` drop-in (fine) — owner could drop `minecraft_poster.jpg` for consistency.
- `ark` maps to `ark-asa`; if the DB `ark` family is meant to be ASE, swap to `ark-ase` in `ART_SLUG`.
- Wheel handler only acts on horizontal-dominant intent (never hijacks vertical page scroll); if a horizontal-swipe-to-browser-back gesture feels intercepted on trackpads, that's the intended trade-off for carousel control.
- Did not touch the configurator, control panel, pricing, or SEO landing pages per scope. Not built/deployed per instructions.
